# hscc — Hermes Spark Cluster Control

> hscc looks after a small cluster of NVIDIA DGX Spark AI computers and a team of AI agents for you. It starts the models, keeps them running, hands work to the right agent, and restarts anything that falls over — then tells you only when it actually needs you. You watch it from iPhone and Mac widgets, a Live Activity, a CarPlay screen and a menu-bar app. Open source under the MIT license.

hscc is the manager layer on top of sparkrun (which runs vLLM inference on DGX Spark nodes) and Hermes (the agent runtime). It needs a configured sparkrun DGX Spark cluster and Hermes on the control host; it is not hardware. The control host is a Mac or Linux machine. Install the CLI with Homebrew: `brew tap pom11/hscc && brew install hscc && hscc bootstrap --yes`.

## Docs

- [Landing page](https://pom11.github.io/hscc/): what hscc is, why, what it does, templates, commands, the apps, and how to get it
- [Full text for LLMs](https://pom11.github.io/hscc/llms-full.txt): the whole landing page copy as plain Markdown
- [README](https://github.com/pom11/hscc/blob/main/README.md): architecture, setup and operation
- [Changelog](https://github.com/pom11/hscc/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every release
- [HTTP API](https://github.com/pom11/hscc/blob/main/docs/API.md): the read-only API the apps use
- [Fleet guide](https://github.com/pom11/hscc/blob/main/docs/FLEET.md): nodes, serving and templates

## Apps

- [iPhone app](https://pom11.github.io/hscc/ios/): widgets, Lock Screen gauges, the Cluster watch Live Activity and a CarPlay screen (Ad Hoc build; the device must be registered first)
- [Mac menu-bar app and desktop widgets](https://pom11.github.io/hscc/macos/): `brew install --cask pom11/hscc/hscc-widgets`

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/pom11/hscc): Python (CLI, daemon, API) and Swift (iOS and macOS apps), MIT
- [Releases](https://github.com/pom11/hscc/releases)
